name: open-points-reconciliation
body:
Reconciliation of the DEFERRED/open design points in scanner-optimisation against Human decisions taken this session. Each decision is applied to the durable nodes below; nothing remains DEFERRED except genuinely plan-time choices.

1. Markdown links — DEFERRED, out of scope (Human). Retired requirements.requirement.markdown-links-as-edges and requirements.requirement.markdown-exactness-unresolved (nodes + every incident edge removed). Retired the synthesized document-root Struct: it existed only to anchor links, so markdown sections are now just heading Structs and a heading-less document yields only its File. Reconciled requirements.requirement.markdown-frontend (child set), requirements.requirement.markdown-sections-as-symbols, requirements.requirement.markdown-accept-extensions, requirements.requirement.markdown-build-and-acceptance, requirements.requirement.markdown-language-plumbing, domain.entity.markdown-document, domain.value.module-fqn-prefix and requirements.note.markdown-frontend-open-points / requirements.note.markdown-frontend-evidence. domain.service.fact-emission keeps its node (it is driven by many requirements); only the link-driven Drives edges were removed. Deferral documented in requirements.note.markdown-links-deferred (details -> markdown-frontend).

2. Markdown accept set — DECIDED: `.md` and `.markdown` only; `.mdx` is OUT (JSX-embedded, not the markdown frontend's concern). The `.mdx` deferred item is removed.

3. Markdown frontend implementation — DECIDED: a new Rust standalone binary under src/mdlib, built by build.rs and staged as `mdfrontend` (bare-binary convention like pyfrontend/csharpfrontend/rustfrontend). Pinned in requirements.requirement.markdown-build-and-acceptance and solution.component.markdown-frontend; planned code, no implemented-by.

4. Markdown slug rule — DECIDED: GitHub-style, pinned as requirements.constraint.markdown-slug-rule (trim, NFC, lowercase, whitespace -> `-`, drop punctuation except `-`/`_`, preserve non-ASCII letters/digits, duplicates `-1`/`-2`/…). The duplicate-heading fixture is added to the markdown-sections-as-symbols AC.

5. Unified JS/TS Language root — DECIDED: per-stream id — `js` for a JS-only repo, `ts` otherwise (whatever auto-detection selected); the root is the id of the lang_switch stream that produced the modules. requirements.note.language-rooting-open-points #3 marked DECIDED.

6. Python environment model — DECIDED: auto-detect a uv project / virtualenv / bare src root and supply it to `ty`'s project context; site-packages/venv stays a discovery exclusion (never a scan root) available only as a resolution input. Updated requirements.note.python-frontend-open-points #3, domain.constraint.python-exclusions and requirements.requirement.python-frontend.

7. Python Ruff/ty pin currency — DECIDED (policy): pin astral-sh/ruff to a release tag (reference 0.16.6) as git deps, bumped ATOMICALLY (all ty/ruff crates together, lockfile re-pinned) like src/rustlib does for rust-analyzer; the exact tag is confirmed at implementation. Pinned as requirements.constraint.python-ty-ruff-pin-policy and in requirements.requirement.python-build-and-deps; note #4 marked DECIDED.

8. Python incremental target-set granularity — DECIDED: per-package/module (aligned with the package identity model and ty's module-level analysis). The target set is a set of modules/packages; resolution still runs against the full `ty` project. Applied to requirements.requirement.python-incremental-contract, requirements.note.python-frontend-open-points #5 and requirements.note.open-design-points #1.

Spine integrity was re-checked after the edits: no retired node remains referenced, every remaining requirement drives a non-Value domain node that reaches a solution, no Value carries realised-by, and notes keep their details edges.
